programme.title: 地球演化实录 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的岛屿,其多样性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前发生。从加拉帕戈斯群岛走到南极洲,看看海狮、雀鸟、蟋蟀、猴子和其他野生动物,如何以惊人的适应力来应对气候变化问题。

programme.title: 地球演化实录 #3 英普
programme.desc: 从撒哈拉到荒野,于极端环境中学习动物如何适应急速变化的气候并挣扎求存。与黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避难、看看骆驼以特别技巧饮用盐水,并倾听斑胸草雀为蛋宝宝由唱的歌,了解歌声如何让幼雏变得细小。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #3 英普
programme.desc: 到非洲窥探野生动物终生不懈的寻找水源之旅。见证地球上最壮观的海洋觅食狂潮、了解眼镜蛇的太阳能储备,并跟随牛羚与大象家族踏上壮阔的迁徙之旅。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 野狗群的世界正在面对一场巨变,他们丰富的狩猎地正受到斑点鬣狗群的威胁。脆弱的狗宝宝已开始挨饿,因为无情的猎食者对手偷走了他们的食物,最终还突击他们的栖身地。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 对狮子来说,水牛固然是令人满足的晚餐,但同时也是危险的猎物。与穆瓦姆巴狮群一起追踪为数近三百头水牛,并从中窥探他们的猎食技巧,他们必须迅速而谨慎地行动。

programme.title: 啄木鸟: 树洞故事
programme.desc: 伴随著一个独特的鸟类家族的稳定鼓点行进。了解为何世界上从大到小的239种啄木鸟都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠们的飞行、攀爬和呼叫技能;进入牠们的秘密巢穴一探究竟。

programme.title: 城市野生拯救队 #9
programme.desc: 这部12集的纪录片系列将显示哪些动物居住在城市中,以及牠们遇到了甚么麻烦。当牠们需要帮助时,一队拯救队将会出动。每年有成千上万的动物获得新生,只因志愿者和专业人士一同为热爱的大自然出力。

programme.title: 澳大利亚的隐藏之岛 #3 英普
programme.desc: 圣诞岛位于澳洲大陆西北一千多公里,是一个从印度洋拔地而起的岛屿,是世上独一无二的植物和动物的小庇护所。鸟类统治它的天空,惊艳的景致也是数百万迁徙者奇迹般的舞台。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #3
programme.desc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而闻名: 从每年冬季到访的座头鲸到常驻该处的鲸鲨。但仔细观察就可以发现一个很少被探索的微小物种的神秘世界。虽然经常被忽视,牠们对所居住的生态系统同样重要。在这个野生和无法预测的海岸,海洋科学家们不惜一切地保护著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得为时已晚。

programme.title: 猴之岛 #1
programme.desc: 斯里兰卡的森林是猴子的天堂,但不是猴猴平等。安娜坐在社交阶梯的底层,还带著刚出生的婴儿,生活变得更艰难。该地区的紧张局势又随著干旱升温,安娜是一位伟大的母亲,但牠能保存孩子的性命吗?

programme.title: 猴之岛 #2
programme.desc: 曾是斯里兰卡国王的古老城堡现已被森林所回收,改朝换代后掌权的是猴子。

programme.title: 猴之岛 #3
programme.desc: 缨冠灰叶猴与一群兰卡猕猴和一群紫面叶猴共享领土,在斯里兰卡古老的寺庙中休憩,那里是灵长类的天堂。但一次严重的干旱改变了一切,牠们被迫作出适应并冒一些风险。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜达卢普岛附近,顶尖鲨鱼生态学家莫利斯奥许尤士先使用遥视。他将摄影机安装在大白鲨的鳍上,拍摄到一个独特的视野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩猎,并且最终袭击猎物。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #2 英普
programme.desc: 前往巴哈马的偏远地区,解开鲨鱼的秘密。牠们交友吗?牠们在哪里生育?有品种比其他大胆吗?答案可能有助保护这些至高无上掠食者的后代。

programme.title: 不羁尚比亚 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷有一片乌木树林,是一群狒狒的家园。但这里存在著危险 - 与其他掠食者不同,同为居民的猎豹具有足够的强大和敏捷性来爬树。牠不是容易逃避的敌人。

programme.title: 不羁尚比亚 #2 英普
programme.desc: 卢安瓜谷的平原和林地住著最狂野和最无情的动物,捕食者和猎物间的对决日以继夜进行著。对于称它为家的动物来说,每天都要靠战斗生存下去。

programme.title: 不羁尚比亚 #3 英普
programme.desc: 随著旱季开始,成千上万的动物正前往相思环。每头动物都必须在捕食顺序中确立自己的位置,避免那些非常愿意以粗心的动物作大餐的危险居民。

programme.title: 不羁尚比亚 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麦兹家族中最年轻的小牛。随著气温飙升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭。逼使毛拉和牠的家人进行一次漫长而危险的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源: 卢安瓜河。

programme.title: 狒狒: 部落的法则
programme.desc: 跟随四个不同物种的四个家族-足智多谋的海滩族、好战的沙漠族、纪律严明的河族和爱好和平的山族,找出这些灵长类成为非洲最成功动物之一的原因。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #1 英普
programme.desc: 抬头观看澳洲的天空,它经常为世界带来最极端的天气现象。与众生一起等待清凉的季风雨降临,看看闪电如何引燃大规模的野火,并惊叹不同物种为适应这些极端环境,所展现的奇妙生存智慧。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #2 英普
programme.desc: 仰望北美洲的天际,体验强大而绚丽的自然现象。见证北极熊在极光下寻找食物,追踪极地涡旋的冰冷路径,并跟随草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龙卷风。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #3 英普
programme.desc: 到非洲窥探野生动物终生不懈的寻找水源之旅。见证地球上最壮观的海洋觅食狂潮、了解眼镜蛇的太阳能储备,并跟随牛羚与大象家族踏上壮阔的迁徙之旅。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​观看初学者第一次跃入空中的瞬间,就像一只安地斯神鹰必须先去飞行学校接受训练,然后才有可能展开双翼翱翔。遇见那些没有羽毛却能高飞的奇特家伙,并惊叹游隼高速俯冲捕捉猎物的惊人速度,也赞叹牠下坠时抓取猎物的猛烈迅捷。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与那些在半空中善于抓猎的飞行者一起出猎,观看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蜕变的过程,欣赏仓鸮悄然无声靠近猎物的潜行方式,并捕捉一只流浪的蝾螈纵身一跃跳入深渊的惊险飞跃。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与那些在空中交配游戏中胜出的动物碰面,与一只正调制专属的爱情药水蜜蜂一起起飞。观看一只飞蜥为了抵御对手而展翼滑翔,并见证一对日本丹顶鹤透过优雅的双人舞姿缔结一生的羁绊。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看动物穿越天空展开非凡的旅程。穿梭在木制迷宫中的迅捷苍鹰,加入沙鸡艰辛远行到遥远水源的跋涉,并观赏一群椋鸟形成的壮观集体盘旋,迷惑牠们的天敌。

programme.title: 澳大利亚的隐藏之岛 #4 英普
programme.desc: 弗雷泽岛位于大堡礁和南回归线的南部,像一只爬行中的蜥蜴。 弗雷泽岛长约120公里,宽达25公里,是现世最大的沙岛。在这种贫瘠的沙床上却离奇地生机勃勃。澳洲野犬在森林搜寻小袋鼠,而白腹海雕从天上搜索沙滩。从湖泊到森林再至清澈的溪流,弗雷泽岛是一个混杂不同色彩,独特又不可思议的栖息地,更荣获了世界遗产的美誉。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #4
programme.desc: 海洋占据地球的70%,是多达一百万种已知动植物的家园。但巩固全球最大食物网的却是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物。这些微生物漂流在海洋的众多栖息地,所到之处就会触发觅食周期。没有牠们,海洋中的生命将不复存在。

programme.title: 精灵之国 #1
programme.desc: 马达加斯加大狐猴indris是现存原猴类中体型最大的类群,他们每天在雨林中寻找食物和躲避捕食者。让我们看看这些濒临灭绝的灵长类动物如何在迅速缩小的栖息地中克服一切困难生存下来。

programme.title: 精灵之国 #2
programme.desc: 游览马达加斯加高耸的山脉、茂密的热带雨林、树木繁茂的沿海平原和干燥的沙漠。看看侏罗纪时代的植物、古老的青蛙和爬行动物物种,以及新的漂流者是如何在这些奇特而美丽的风景中进化的。

programme.title: 精灵之国 #3
programme.desc: 马达加斯加有近400种爬行动物,约占世界冷血动物的一半。观看变色龙、蛇和300多种五颜六色的青蛙在岛上的极端气候中茁壮成长。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #3 英普
programme.desc: 海中最快的鱼,尖吻鲭鲨通常是恒温的,这使牠具有敏捷思维以及惊人速度的优势。跟随这种纽西兰海岸附近相对未被研究的品种。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #4 英普
programme.desc: 鲨鱼经常被描绘成容易攻击人类的无脑进食机器,但是它们的行为比之前所认为的更加复杂和聪明。找出这些优雅的顶级捕食者如何互动,选择朋友,甚至训导其他同类。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #6 英普
programme.desc: 从修剪整齐的稻田到野性热带雨林,湄公河是泰国东部的生命之源。一起走访河岸,看看长臂猿如何处理家庭纠纷,并暸解腹蛇如何为该区脆弱的生命网络带来威胁。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #7 英普
programme.desc: 柬埔寨被系于湄公河的水域网络之中,因此与这条大河的关系密不可分。看看这个国家如何展现生物多样性,并见证动物族群如何在未受破坏的自然栖息地中找到秘密庇护所。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #8 英普
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命线,尤其是在酷热难耐的旱季,宝贵的水分几乎难以寻觅。深入探索并了解各式各样能展翅飞翔的生物,无论是鸟类还是蝙蝠,牠们在缺水的漫长日子里,善加运用并精打细算管理仅有的资源,直到雨季降临、甘甜的雨水带来久违的慰藉与舒缓。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最后一个国家是湄公河三角洲的发源地。大量营养丰富的物质从数百里外的河流顺流而下,使此地成为越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物宝库。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #10 英普
programme.desc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一。迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通过九条水道绵延流入南海。这些水道分割并塑造了海岸线,为各种动物创造了独特的栖息地。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #4 英普
programme.desc: 了解南美洲多变的气候如何孕育更丰富多样的生命。寻找亚马逊雨林中能够「呼吸」氧气的树木、追随广阔的云河轨迹,并拜会能在猛烈紫外线下茁壮成长的红鹤。

programme.title: 野外纪事 #1 英普
programme.desc: 每年头几个月里,地轴的倾斜为某些地方带来夏天,某些地方则是冬天。了解生物如何在这些极端条件下生存。

programme.title: 野外纪事 #2 英普
programme.desc: 从遍及日本的樱花浪潮到最终到达大堡礁产卵的绿海龟群,环游世界去见证三月发生的大气变化,

programme.title: 野外纪事 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在北半球观察夏季来临,靠近赤道的地区进入雨季,而南非则变得干旱,这使生物的数量变得悬殊。

programme.title: 野外纪事 #4 英普
programme.desc: 从夏季融化的北极冰层,至到达阿拉斯加旅程尽头的红鲑觅食狂潮,于7月见证地球上一些最戏剧性的自然变化。

programme.title: 野外纪事 #5 英普
programme.desc: 环游世界去察看另一个季节性转变。北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲见证一次重生,汤加温暖的热带海域充满交配的座头鲸。

programme.title: 野外纪事 #6 英普
programme.desc: 于11月见证大自然一些最不可思议的事,从聚在墨西哥森林中的数百万只君主斑蝶,到笼罩著杜拜市的浓雾,标志著冬天的开始。

programme.title: 城市野生拯救队 #11

programme.title: 地球演化实录 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的岛屿,其多样性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前发生。从加拉帕戈斯群岛走到南极洲,看看海狮、雀鸟、蟋蟀、猴子和其他野生动物,如何以惊人的适应力来应对气候变化问题。

programme.title: 地球演化实录 #3 英普
programme.desc: 从撒哈拉到荒野,于极端环境中学习动物如何适应急速变化的气候并挣扎求存。与黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避难、看看骆驼以特别技巧饮用盐水,并倾听斑胸草雀为蛋宝宝由唱的歌,了解歌声如何让幼雏变得细小。

programme.title: 狂野天空 #3 英普
programme.desc: 到非洲窥探野生动物终生不懈的寻找水源之旅。见证地球上最壮观的海洋觅食狂潮、了解眼镜蛇的太阳能储备,并跟随牛羚与大象家族踏上壮阔的迁徙之旅。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 野狗群的世界正在面对一场巨变,他们丰富的狩猎地正受到斑点鬣狗群的威胁。脆弱的狗宝宝已开始挨饿,因为无情的猎食者对手偷走了他们的食物,最终还突击他们的栖身地。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 对狮子来说,水牛固然是令人满足的晚餐,但同时也是危险的猎物。与穆瓦姆巴狮群一起追踪为数近三百头水牛,并从中窥探他们的猎食技巧,他们必须迅速而谨慎地行动。

programme.title: 啄木鸟: 树洞故事
programme.desc: 伴随著一个独特的鸟类家族的稳定鼓点行进。了解为何世界上从大到小的239种啄木鸟都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠们的飞行、攀爬和呼叫技能;进入牠们的秘密巢穴一探究竟。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #1 英普
programme.desc: 与非洲森林象一同穿越纳米比亚沙漠,窥探牠们如何在缺乏食物与遮蔽的环境中保持凉爽。了解这头巨兽如何挑选特定植物充饥、挖掘水井,并翻越无尽的沙丘寻找珍贵水源。

programme.title: 创造之岛
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一个偏远群岛的丛林中,一位生物学家正尝试做著查理斯达尔文和恩斯特迈尔的未竟之事: 在新物种创造过程中捕捉进化的身影。怀艾伯特在所罗门群岛即将有一个惊人的发现,但一个危机慢慢逼近。

programme.title: 大白鲨的秘密
programme.desc: 鲨鱼是怪物吗?还是已经被妖魔化?这部纪录片探讨大白鲨本性背后的真相。

programme.title: 街头美食通 #8
programme.desc: 安斯利来到摩洛哥,但他没有去马拉喀什或卡萨布兰加,而是去了丰富多彩、混乱而梦幻的费兹。杂乱无序的麦地那是世界遗产,也是通往另一个时代的门户。

programme.title: 街头美食通 #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到访槟岛首都乔治敦,马来西亚人发现这个沉迷美食的国家中最好的街头食品。

programme.title: 街头美食通 #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最后一站到访问约旦的安曼,那是来自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和叙利亚中东一族叫作家的交汇处。

programme.title: 艾伦康明最奢华的火车之旅: 苏格兰 #1
programme.desc: 艾伦从爱丁堡出发,探索一列奢华列车,与列车主厨会面,造访二战与雅各宾纪念地,漫步于莫拉的银白沙滩,并了解西高地铁路的工程奇迹。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 体验鲁阿佩胡地区正崛起的饮食文化,以及悠久的市集园艺历史。他拜访了一位第六代农夫,该农夫将一片偏远荒野打造成繁荣的生态旅游与高级餐饮目的地,并与一位屡获殊荣的主厨合作。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅从南岛西岸展开。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座农场遇见了全纽西兰唯一的蔓越莓生产者,接著前往布莱克波尔(Blackball)学习腊肠(chorizo)的制作过程。Ben 随后在海滩上烹调出多道结合这些在地美味的料理,并搭配当地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #1
programme.desc: 在圣露西亚,双胞胎惊喜现身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探险、丛林健行、极致享受的巧克力按摩、兰姆酒品鉴,热带乐趣无限延伸!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰岛,邦妮与双胞胎展开史诗冒险——赏鲸、火山健行、策马奔驰,还有极光下的深度环保对话。

programme.title: 艾伦康明最奢华的火车之旅: 苏格兰 #2
programme.desc: 艾伦在列车上享受水疗设施,造访威姆斯湾,参观布特岛上的斯图亚特山庄,欣赏珍贵的莎士比亚原稿,探索列车工作人员区域,参与刺激冒险,并造访皮特洛赫里的著名山顶剧院。

programme.title: 艾伦康明最奢华的火车之旅: 苏格兰 #3
programme.desc: 艾伦的奢华列车之旅持续展开,欣赏车厢美景,了解卡洛登的历史,在普洛克顿观察海豹,聆听牧牛故事,体验驾驶列车,品尝威士忌,观察老鹰,并在乡间享受瑜伽的宁静时光。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #1

programme.desc: Ben 体验鲁阿佩胡地区正崛起的饮食文化,以及悠久的市集园艺历史。他拜访了一位第六代农夫,该农夫将一片偏远荒野打造成繁荣的生态旅游与高级餐饮目的地,并与一位屡获殊荣的主厨合作。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅从南岛西岸展开。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座农场遇见了全纽西兰唯一的蔓越莓生产者,接著前往布莱克波尔(Blackball)学习腊肠(chorizo)的制作过程。Ben 随后在海滩上烹调出多道结合这些在地美味的料理,并搭配当地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #1
programme.desc: 在圣露西亚,双胞胎惊喜现身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探险、丛林健行、极致享受的巧克力按摩、兰姆酒品鉴,热带乐趣无限延伸!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰岛,邦妮与双胞胎展开史诗冒险——赏鲸、火山健行、策马奔驰,还有极光下的深度环保对话。

programme.title: 揭秘芭比: 分裂的梦幻屋
programme.desc: 《揭秘芭比: 分裂的梦幻屋》揭示创作芭比娃娃背后的戏剧性真实故事,重点讲述联合创作者罗丝韩德勒和杰克瑞恩的高山与低谷,以及他们标志性又备受争议发明的持久影响。

programme.title: 美国总统录 #1
programme.desc: 祖拜登于2021年1月20日就任美国第46任总统,承诺在分裂的时代后团结和镇静,目标是「恢复美国魂」。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 约克郡 #4
programme.desc: 尽管冬季迟来,但对文斯卡海滩的灰海豹来说,冬天就代表著分娩的时间。新生的幼崽现正快速步入成年,在牠们的母亲继续前行前,只有三周的时间来尽量增加体重。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #1
programme.desc: 认识新任野外战士义工,他们将加入韦札的动物大家庭。变脏是工作的一部分。当然,随时会有冲击性的惊喜。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #2
programme.desc: 我们在本集目睹一场拯救一只受惊黑高角羚的绝望任务。这些反偷猎的大象智慧震惊所有人。而且,总能忙里偷闲。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #3
programme.desc: 义工们在本集近距离接触标志性的动物。深入了解韦札的反偷猎成就。还有,努力无坚不摧。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #4
programme.desc: 义工们探索社区在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人兴奋的蜂蜜收成、新团员的加入,以及其中一人喂哺黑犀牛的梦想成真。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入胜的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的梦想。茱迪心爱的麂羚是时候回归大自然。例行的东非条纹羚捕捉行动发生意想不到的转折。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一个疣猪回收行动出了差错。来认识韦札保育区的母系社会,一头奇特大象的独家故事。是时候告别韦札的家人。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #1
programme.desc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生动物。冬天带来严苛的风暴、苦难和冲突,大多数动物都要为生存而战。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #2
programme.desc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生机盎然。在深海水域过冬的鱼群再度回归。一对老鹰在完美捕鱼点的高空筑巢。

programme.title: 消失的录影带 2 #2
programme.desc: 按时序再体验太阳神13号险些酿成的灾难,这是美国太空总署同时最具破坏性和最美好的时刻之一。通过新闻片段、任务控制的音频和美国太空总署的存档见证1970年4月的事件。

programme.title: 消失的录影带 2 #3
programme.desc: 通过警察的音频和视频,还有当地及国家新闻报道,审 视2002年华盛顿特区的狙击手袭击事件。狙击手为期三周的恐怖统治引发了美国史上最激烈、最复杂的搜捕行动之一。

programme.title: 消失的录影带 2 #4
programme.desc: 透过罕见的档案录像审视民权社运人士麦尔坎X的迅速崛起和悲剧下场。

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #3
programme.desc: 翱翔于广阔的沙漠、巨大的钻石和​​世上最大的内陆绿洲之上。

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #4
programme.desc: 从数千英尺高空探索西开普省迷人的海岸线、注目的山脉和多样性的大都会。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 约克郡 #3
programme.desc: 夏季持续,秋天暂且未到,出人意料的宜人天气为西方狍们提供了一条救命稻草,因牠们正为即将到来的冬季做准备。至于其他动物,交配季节已到,在文斯卡海滩充满了睾酮的气息。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 约克郡 #4
programme.desc: 尽管冬季迟来,但对文斯卡海滩的灰海豹来说,冬天就代表著分娩的时间。新生的幼崽现正快速步入成年,在牠们的母亲继续前行前,只有三周的时间来尽量增加体重。

programme.desc: Dr Matt gets up close and personal with Albert, Flamingoland's 12-foot alligator, as he moves to a new home Teddy the pet sheep has suspected calcium deficiency and needs emergency treatment, and Marcel the marmoset leads Matt a merry dance around the surgery Back at Flamingoland, a reluctant macaw needs his beak trimming -V and Matt comes face-to-face with the new pride of lions

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this episode of the Dog rescuers we see Alan return to the one of the Uk's busiest animal hospitals in his new role as vet assistant This time he's helping out vet Alex as she tackles Gladys the puppy and a case of mange

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: Safari Flix
programme.desc: Safari Flix is hosted by an experienced rangerguide who provides compelling in-the-moment narration on the action as it happens Not only will viewers marvel at the incredible wildlife sightings featured in the show, but so too will they be exposed to a wealth of information on the animals in particular and the African bush and pressing environmental matters in general

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation

programme.desc: The Oceanic White Tip is one of the only sharks that makes Ian Gordon nervous Fast, aggressive pack-hunters, these sharks wander the open ocean preying on whatever they can find

programme.title: 海豹特击队(第七季) #2

programme.title: F9狂野时速

programme.desc: 哈迪斯答应了吉儿的请求,饶了贝鲁侯爵一命。但贝鲁侯爵竟反过来以无情的字眼辱骂哈迪斯是「披著人皮的怪物」。担心哈迪斯太过勉强自己的吉儿,会采取什么行动呢?

programme.title: 成为名留青史的坏女人吧 #8
programme.desc: 结束修行的艾莉西亚已满15岁,成了一位亭亭玉立的少女。魔法能力提升的艾莉西亚前往罗亚纳村,做出惊人之举。这件事很快地在杜克的心中掀起波澜,这阵波澜最终也动摇了艾莉西亚的心

programme.title: 海贼王 #493
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房间发现了小时候妮可写给他的信。守仁表示他将信贴在墙上长达五年,每天都受到这封信的鼓励。因为今天是母亲的忌日,守仁独自一人前往扫墓。另一方面,监志、圭护、见晴及来乙木家玩的音梦从妮可口中听到了她与现在有些不同的小时候守仁的往事。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #20
programme.desc: 圭护若没有看见弯月图案就无法发挥强大的力量。妮可看见圭护脸上浮现出落寞的表情,于是交给他一枚注入了「飞行魔法」的戒指。圭护怀抱著「只要能灵活使用应该就能成为一种武器」这个想法开始进行特训。某天,音梦找正在进行秘密特训的圭护讲话。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #21
programme.desc: 圭护因为频道的影片播放次数没有起色而感到烦恼。他找同居人妮可、守仁、监志及见晴商量,结果被狠狠地吐槽「因为你的频道不有趣啦!」。为了让影片有看头,圭护拜托妮可在影片中串场被守仁一口回绝。于是妮可对圭护施展了让他自己变成「女孩子」的魔法。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #22
programme.desc: 妮可在房间内和伽罗跟守仁一起举办狂吃甜甜圈的派对。伽罗大口享用甜甜圈并表示碰上讨厌的事情或疲累时就是要吃甜甜圈!妮可为了体验只要是女孩子都曾梦想过的甜点世界,决定尝试用魔法将身体变小尽情享受甜甜圈。

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会港福堂

programme.title: 王一平牧师-一言道破

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 拥有多元宗教及种族的新加坡, 在各种文化互相碰撞下产生出一套新的峇峇娘惹文化, 造就了新加坡独特的手工艺 - 娘惹绣珠鞋、纱笼可峇雅及娘惹心口针 并成为新加坡引以为傲的文化遗产

programme.title: 翻生工程粤英
programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 昆达山景色怡人，马贯东随三位美女激玩越野四驱车，但嘉欣出发不久即向教练呼救？写意环境下畅快飞驰，敏之解开人母束缚，展现贪玩一面。四人及后深入茶园采茶，再登上树屋叹一杯，享受慢活节奏。说到儿时志愿，高Ling、嘉欣喜欢小朋友，均曾希望成为幼稚园老师。除了演艺工作，各人现时又有甚么计划？夕阳美景映衬下，一行人到可可山打卡，还即席演绎经典影视场面，贯东变身少女大撒娇！玩得兴起，四人更High爆热舞！

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤PG
programme.desc: 轻松郊游，打卡打到尽头！Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰向香港最南端的蒲台岛进发，必吃岛上紫菜餐蛋面、海带绿豆沙，沿途探索珍贵石刻与奇石，远观呈现人形僧人石、灵龟上山石，好神奇！顺利征服终站灯塔，任务完成。祖仪、淑雅共度泰式宅度假，打泰拳、泰式按摩与细味泰国菜，不用飞都「泰」识叹！衍峰再接再厉，领祖仪、嘉宾陈诗欣寻访西贡隐世小岛盐田梓，参观百年村校、港版盐田，学做正宗茶粿，认识传承已久的本地客家文化。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: Hip Hop(嘻哈)文化起源于上世纪七十年代的纽约，涵盖饶舌、DJ、街舞与涂鸦四大要素。谷主凯文指，这文化的诞生时间可精准至1973年8 月11日晚上九时，何出此言？她亦逐一介绍上述要素的特色，并提到街舞的出现有效减少暴力冲突。嘻哈不仅是音乐，更是一种生活方式，其核心精神是「真实」，包括自我表达、反抗社会不公等。谷主凯婷以内地的嘻哈主题音乐节目为例，称这文化已透过不同形式逐渐从次文化走向主流。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 一路前行粤普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中国生态保护，绿色高品质发展的环保公益纪实节目。透过沉浸式观察新时代环保议题，并邀请胡歌、刘涛、陈龙三位明星亲身参与，共同完成一场绿色低碳生活的行动。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粤
programme.desc: 本集Gigi姐为大家介绍一道很健康的素食「豆腐煮双耳」。双耳所指的是云耳和银耳，配合煎香了的硬豆腐，还有腐乳来提味，既美味又健康。Gigi姐也会向大家讲解银耳、雪耳、木耳和云耳的分别，还有挑选的准则。

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 节目组让孩子们试吃不同地方的早餐，俄罗斯小朋友竟对咸豆浆、粢饭甚为喜欢？永城带两位港孩到访韩国小朋友家中，体验彼邦的家庭文化。「韩式饭卷」是当地代表食物，韩裔妈妈引领大家DIY，各人亦会一尝自己的成品。「掷柶戏」是可多人参与的韩国传统游戏，如何进行？嬉戏过后，港、韩孩子还会随导师学习K-pop舞蹈。两位港孩趁着「你我」课题，探访三个不同国家小朋友的家居，众人直率地不分种族，融洽打成一片，教人欣喜。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 敌人意欲破坏捕捉墙，却突然收手离去。阿茜未能合体，继续私底下练习，良太和太晴则表现得爱理不理，舞和伽马看不过眼，屡次想插手，太晴和良太决定给予阿茜空间，等他自行交出理想答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 儿童体适能教练Yuki姐姐首次登场，先带来趣味十足的肌力训练。她将猫、牛、鳄鱼、袋鼠等动物的动作融入运动中，令锻练过程更添乐趣。稍作休息后，「WORKOUT 2GETHER」继续进行。另一组核心训练同样有趣，Yuki姐姐提到会教授天鹅式、美人鱼式等动作，做法令人期待。「动物好萌友」环节，这回介绍肉食性昆虫兰花螳螂。牠会捕食破坏农作物的害虫，是农夫们的好帮手。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 全班分组做观察报告。小丸子不幸被编配到，与说话尖酸刻薄的永泽在同一组。而且，永泽还成为了组长。另一方面，与小玉同组的成员，全是一些气势迫人及很有主见的人。被选为组长的小玉，感到很难驾驭他们。

programme.title: 危机现场粤
programme.desc: 本片选取近年来国内最具代表性的安全事故和自然灾害，作科学分析，重现处置过程，展现当下中国应急救援专业能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事发原因和调查过程，解读事故隐患。同时，展示人类的勇气、智慧与无畏。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 政府2021年提出北部都会区概念，但区内洪水桥、古洞和打鼓岭等新发展区，其实早于2007年已被列为「十大基建项目」，开始规划和发展。虽然政府近年精简程序，但现时估计去到2033年，区内仍会有六成土地未平整好，要到2043年，整个发展才会大致完成。北都发展进程横跨数十年，为甚么要花那么长时间？政府建议设立专属法例，精简程序和放宽要求，是否有助加快发展？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 多次收到短讯指已寄件？事主担心如寄件物属违禁品会惹祸上身，向相关物流公司反映问题。将军澳居民反映其居所附近有通宵小贩摆档，带来不少问题，管理公司有何跟进措施？有公屋住户投诉邨内鼠辈横行，几只老鼠先后爬上铁闸，并在走廊「游荡」，俨如一个老鼠游乐场，疑是与邻居囤物有关。摄制队到现场拍摄，惊见同一层有两间杂物屋？《魔音女团》练习生到商场与公众见面，送上活动花絮。

programme.title: 汇丰保险呈献：退休有乜计粤
programme.desc: 微退休是指短暂远离职场，为人生「充电」。著名魔术师甄泽权几年前于生日当天突然不适，令其萌生休息念头，还透露以露营车环游世界的心愿。星级时装设计师姚子裕自揭如何在工作中放空，并谈到微退休心态与旅居外地的愿景。众主持访问一对哈尔滨夫妇，了解他们在珠海经营民宿的微退休生活；王祖蓝夫妻另到访退休人士俱乐部，并挑战室内跳伞。曾展望、叶蒨文则体验泰国皇室指定的疗养中心；又聆听旅居泰国港人的「泰」舒适生活故事。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈献:唱钱粤
programme.desc: 音准、拍子大考验，唱歌随时有钱落袋！香港青年乒乓球手喜爱街头Busking，也参加过不同歌唱比赛；「义眼少年」克服障碍，勇敢追寻音乐梦。两位素人参加者分别接受《唱钱》洗礼，透过挑战Sing盘上不同歌曲难度「过三关」，甚至是最难的Monster关卡，向打爆九宫格的目标进发。观众只需用手机扫描萤幕上的QR Code，即可参与直播室互动，为挑战者打气，更有机会赢取福利。

programme.title: 伯乐音乐学院20周年呈献：J Music粤
programme.desc: 太极将举行成军40年演唱会，更接纳粉丝意见，精选一些少唱的歌曲，并重新编曲。至于《J Music》观众则可欣赏乐队现场演绎的<缘、<留住我吧与<沉默风暴。胡子彤到来送上新歌<我独自升级，而陈苡臻藉歌声<击败99%，巧合的是两首作品均由黄伟文于无沟通情况「私下」填词！另外，节目会倒数「劲歌金榜」，并邀得许志安接受访谈，提到阔别三年的广东歌<信天翁，实是作曲人点名要将这歌交给安仔唱出？

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 大厨邓浩宏带何泳芍品尝大排档风味小炒，包括香辣惹味的避风塘炒蟹、咸香的啫啫芥兰爽肉煲，皆镬气十足。行仔与鼎爷造访星级食府，细尝鹅肝金钱鸡、松茸炖水中花，以及砂锅极品炒饭，将传统粤菜「翻新兼升呢」。食评家KC带波波品尝正宗顺德菜，煎焗鱼咀、啫啫竹肠鱼卜等佳肴以河鱼不同部位炮制，滋味独特。有餐厅推出会员限定优惠餐，包括下午茶时段供应的25元餐蛋面，以及上午11时后便供应的焗斑腩饭，均配饮品，味道如何？

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 小将张乐儿、钟冠熹细说投身射击运动缘由，以及早前代表香港出战亚青赛感受。有本地龙舟队凝聚华洋健儿的力量，外籍长者队员谈及龙舟运动的变化。场地单车世界杯在港上演，这集搜罗首日比赛精华。少年三人篮球赛集结不同组别的篮儿，藉竞技传递正能量。亚洲沙滩运动会将于三亚揭幕，港队举行授旗仪式。滑浪风帆港将郑清然以水上运动大使身分出席活动，并预告比赛动向。另带来田径系列赛的短跑战报，以及体育节开幕礼暨嘉年华盛况。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 金价高企，不少人买黄金保值，其中用硬足金打造的金饰，更特别受市场欢迎。近年香港锐意发展IP产业，本地同海外业界如何看，这方面的机遇？

programme.title: 叠影狙击#17粤PG
programme.desc: 晟杰带人使计进入唐楼一户救出差点死在Tina手里的晓晨，晓晨让Tina说出梁曦害死Simon的证据。文诺为文雅开翡翠珠宝店，他试探晓晨后让她加入洗黑钱，晓晨想抢走一批黑钱，一帮神秘劫匪突然出现，更发现家明当卧底。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 多次收到短讯指已寄件？事主担心如寄件物属违禁品会惹祸上身，向相关物流公司反映问题。将军澳居民反映其居所附近有通宵小贩摆档，带来不少问题，管理公司有何跟进措施？有公屋住户投诉邨内鼠辈横行，几只老鼠先后爬上铁闸，并在走廊「游荡」，俨如一个老鼠游乐场，疑是与邻居囤物有关。摄制队到现场拍摄，惊见同一层有两间杂物屋？《魔音女团》练习生到商场与公众见面，送上活动花絮。

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤PG
programme.desc: 轻松郊游，打卡打到尽头！Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰向香港最南端的蒲台岛进发，必吃岛上紫菜餐蛋面、海带绿豆沙，沿途探索珍贵石刻与奇石，远观呈现人形僧人石、灵龟上山石，好神奇！顺利征服终站灯塔，任务完成。祖仪、淑雅共度泰式宅度假，打泰拳、泰式按摩与细味泰国菜，不用飞都「泰」识叹！衍峰再接再厉，领祖仪、嘉宾陈诗欣寻访西贡隐世小岛盐田梓，参观百年村校、港版盐田，学做正宗茶粿，认识传承已久的本地客家文化。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: Hip Hop(嘻哈)文化起源于上世纪七十年代的纽约，涵盖饶舌、DJ、街舞与涂鸦四大要素。谷主凯文指，这文化的诞生时间可精准至1973年8 月11日晚上九时，何出此言？她亦逐一介绍上述要素的特色，并提到街舞的出现有效减少暴力冲突。嘻哈不仅是音乐，更是一种生活方式，其核心精神是「真实」，包括自我表达、反抗社会不公等。谷主凯婷以内地的嘻哈主题音乐节目为例，称这文化已透过不同形式逐渐从次文化走向主流。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 昆达山景色怡人，马贯东随三位美女激玩越野四驱车，但嘉欣出发不久即向教练呼救？写意环境下畅快飞驰，敏之解开人母束缚，展现贪玩一面。四人及后深入茶园采茶，再登上树屋叹一杯，享受慢活节奏。说到儿时志愿，高Ling、嘉欣喜欢小朋友，均曾希望成为幼稚园老师。除了演艺工作，各人现时又有甚么计划？夕阳美景映衬下，一行人到可可山打卡，还即席演绎经典影视场面，贯东变身少女大撒娇！玩得兴起，四人更High爆热舞！

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 永城这集引领小朋友翻开「美丑」课题，先要大家说出最喜欢与眼中最美的艺人，永城是某孩子的选择？长得美丽可会有好处？众人各有想法。节目组还让小朋友尝试从两个同品种的水果中选择较好味一个，他们从中领略到外观美丽的水果不一定较滋味。三位孩子互相拍照，永城看过作品，决定亲自指导影靓相的技巧。永城要求两位女生于园艺店内，各自选出认为最美与最丑的植物，她们有甚么准则？大家又尝试竞猜植物的价钱，又可会跟外表挂钩？

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 拥有多元宗教及种族的新加坡, 在各种文化互相碰撞下产生出一套新的峇峇娘惹文化, 造就了新加坡独特的手工艺 - 娘惹绣珠鞋、纱笼可峇雅及娘惹心口针 并成为新加坡引以为傲的文化遗产

programme.title: 翻生工程粤英
programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 经营近半世纪的眼镜店舖位细细，虽然「单眼仔睇榜 － 一眼睇晒」，店内多款眼镜各有特色，还吸引演艺圈「潮人」专诚捧场！香港不乏爱马之人，许多赛马术语更已变成流行俚语，学者廖舜禧「出马」解读。不少俗语与颜色有关，如「三分颜色上大红」、「戴绿帽」等，究竟有何出处？「托大脚」原来与中国古代皇帝有关，且听舜禧逐一拆解。老字号面店里，黄耀英「攞住碌竹」学造竹升面，却被吴幸美笑称「棺材拐杖」，究竟怎么回事？

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 结婚嫁女饼款式多多，美味之余还各有吉祥寓意，难怪引来「砧板蚁－ 为食鬼」！中秋节临近，中式饼店师傅讲解月饼制作过程。月饼价钱并不便宜，上一代港人还要每月拿出薪金「供月饼」，有何原因？广东美食仿如「三水佬睇走马灯－ 陆续有莅」，但遇见「油炸蟹」、「土鲮鱼」却要避之则吉？乘搭小巴亦可发现香港传统特色，经典小巴「水牌」更成为至潮香港手信！「写字人」麦师傅还会亲身示范「小巴牌」特色字体。

programme.title: Do姐有问题粤PG
programme.desc: 清迈有炸鸡师傅每天将手放进沸油中，他受了甚么刺激？有何方法令一颗朱古力升价百倍？卢觅雪、阮兆祥为分甘同味，企图自制打和赛果，可惜在祥仔旁边的是被形容为「没带脑上班」的C君，祥仔最终能否尝到黑松露美食？

programme.title: Do姐有问题粤PG
programme.desc: 单立文偕妻子胡蓓蔚担任嘉宾，不停发放笑弹，引得Do姐对他们的相处方式大感好奇。秘鲁青蛙汁有何功效？东京一间没有厨师的食店，食物从何而来？台湾面店老板为何炮制分量足够十人食用的「大碗面」？

programme.title: 打死不离父子兵粤英
programme.desc: 毕德利和巴尼的拉丁美洲公路之旅到了尾声。终站是巴拿马，首先参加一个为保留原住民部落传统而设的祖运会，之后打道去巴拿马城，观赏巴拿马运河，再登上摩天大厦，尝试一下惊险刺激的高空抹窗工作。

programme.title: 打死不离父子兵粤英
programme.desc: 毕德利和巴尼再次踏上另一场史诗般的冒险之旅，向著东方的日本和泰国进发!

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 透过星梦电子蛋，每个星梦频道偶像组合都会拥有一只吉祥物，奇迹闪耀组的吉祥物是闪亮CHU，而Meltic StAr的吉祥物，就是名为玫露熊的熊猫。玫露熊责任感强烈，甚至带有几分神经质，导致她初来不久便与安娜闹翻……

programme.desc: 在一个山清水秀的村子里，奶龙小七平静的生活被打破，暴暴龙为了取代奶龙成为宇宙最强龙，在村子各种使坏，奶龙小七为了阻止其的恶行展开一系列英勇斗争，上演了一幕幕只为能守每个人心中最纯真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 妈妈托爸爸寄信，但爸爸转头便忘记，多啦A梦于是借他「善忘鸟」，提醒他不要忘记寄信。大雄的同学住在火车站附近，可以乘火车上学，多啦A梦于是借他「自组铁路」，让他在家中建造火车站。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星团粤日
programme.desc: B-PRO和Ultras决定参加由西山贵教一手策划的雷神音乐节，作为艺人也有所成长的Ultras，心态已经与当初不同，因为初次登台演唱而紧张不已。B-PRO的成员为了鼓励他们，炒热舞台的气氛，一场爱的呼唤正要开始回响。

programme.title: 到此一游粤
programme.desc: 朱家角古镇历史悠久，被称为「上海威尼斯」。主持陈约临前往河边的旧式茶馆品茶，感受老上海风情；紧接去扫街，试吃手工绿豆糕、喷烟雪糕等网红美食。回到市中心，约临到咖啡旗舰店打卡，细看咖啡豆制作流程，还会初尝结合咖啡豆、啤酒的特饮，好惊喜！七宝古镇的人气饮品店，主打多款创意酸奶，咸蛋黄口味有多特别？由面粉厂区活化而成的创意园区，齐集逾百间文创小店，成为文青必到蒲点！约临闲逛大街小巷，叹咖啡兼疯狂购物。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 现代化水耕农场以先进方法种植新鲜蔬菜，确保吃得健康又卫生。主持们还实地了解「鱼菜共生」，这种有机农法如何持续实践低碳环保的理念？今回示范美食，「参峇酱香煎罗非鱼」以丰富材料炮制酱汁，极其惹味；「竹蔗肥牛卷」配搭创新，带来非凡味觉体验。青芥火箭菜口味辛辣过瘾，多吃紫菜则有助防止脑退化，配上三文鱼制作的「三文鱼水耕菜饭热狗」，怎样将寿司和热狗二合为一？还有「电饭煲沙姜鸡」，以简单快捷方法煮出经典味道。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 野菜马屎苋具清热去湿等多种功效，6号竟误当杂草胡乱践踏？主持们在农场亲手采摘马屎苋及紫法边豆，准备煮好𩠌。肥妈率先奉上「马屎苋两吃」，嫩滑的菜叶以蒜子上汤轻焯；根部则与肉片滚汤，有益脾胃。而「紫豆粟米芯炒猪柳片」更是低卡、降胆固醇之选。「秋葵腐皮卷」中的秋葵不会「滑潺潺」，香煎后既爽脆，还可保持丰富纤维。阿妈另会巧制「韩国泡菜蛋饭酿鱿鱼」，每口尝尽满满的鱿鱼肉和炒饭之外，泡菜与黄姜粉更能凸显滋味！

programme.title: 不可能任务粤PG
programme.desc: 接受谈判组、高空工作队、搜查队、爆炸品处理课的训练后，思贝担任行动指挥官，带领其他女艺员与警「募」大使，参与终极考核任务！跨部门联合演习围绕一宗银行械劫案，涉事银行职员危站天台，韵姿如何劝服职员退回安全位置？畏高的碧莲要在大厦外墙游绳收集证物，表示有思贝在旁就无所畏惧！转往皇后像广场搜索武器，嘉怡却找到一个计时炸弹！慧敏著上防爆衣负责拆弹，期间竟发生爆炸？任务结束，众长官为团队的整体表现评分……

programme.title: 不可能任务粤PG
programme.desc: 徐荣、孔德贤、郑衍峰、林钰洧、梁允瑜检视过往四项《不可能任务》片段，自觉容易应付，节目组遂向五人派遣新任务……先接受以啤牌砌出三层高金字塔的考验，大学修读建造工程的德贤却被难倒？钰洧妙用小智慧，「取巧」过关！五人在香港大学觅路前行，走进了土木工程学系的活动室，获区达光教授给予任务，是要跟小学生比赛；题目是限时三十分钟，采用意大利粉及指定材料搭建桥梁模型，并通过承重测试。艺员们可会不敌一众同学仔？

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 跟过往旅途不尽相同，何沛珈、李芷晴这次放工后才到机场，抵达泰国曼谷已入夜，沛珈未忘为好姊妹准备猛男生日派对，并附大量海鲜！狂欢过后，已是行程第二天。换上校服，走进大学感受校园气息，再到学生长龙店食碗「妈妈面」。花半小时坐车往近郊一间咖啡店，值得吗？原来是网美胜地，还可划小艇和打千秋，打卡、休闲皆一流！创意市集寻宝，她们看上了哪款时装？随后登上由旧飞机改造的餐厅，享用廉价精致餐饮，暂时放低减肥大事。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 沛珈、芷晴租著泰服，再乘观光船往郑王庙留影，打卡初尝教训后，提醒大家要早点到场，究竟怎么回事？两女自言第一次享受Spa，单是拣精油已花去不少时间。然后试试「曼谷十大名厨」之一主理的摘星餐厅菜肴，卖相与美味兼备。走入夜市，当然要买手信！节目组为主持各提供一千泰铢斗买得多，沛珈讲价不成都照买，满脑策略的芷晴执行力又怎样？此外，行程亦有酒吧、设计周活动推介。旅途最后一晚，她们于泳池中互诉心声，感触良多。

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 滋味甜品可算是女士们「最爱的敌人」，皆因甜品往往含有大量糖份，容易致肥。古嘉俊(阿古)今次示范的「黄梅夏威夷果仁挞」，冰凉感觉不但能为炎炎夏日消暑降温，以法国急冻黄梅制成的黄梅杏仁馅料，散发阵阵清新果香，还能让大家暂时忘却节食修身的压力。今集嘉宾庄思明，一向擅长烹饪，这次特意到来向阿古请教甜品制作心得，扬言要为未来日子打算，难道她打算做好准备成为一家之「煮」？

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 翔提出与茜赛跑，如果他胜了，茜便得加入田径部。茜在比赛过程中终于想通并取胜，随后马上前往超铁机，与太晴和良太一起迎战敌人。三人的SRG值达致同步，成功进行三辆合体，却依然陷入苦战。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 梦想是一种能令我们向前迈进的源动力，结他导师诉说自己的寻梦故事，并藉<少年梦，颂唱勇敢追梦的讯息。Tiffany姐姐与彤彤姐姐又曾有甚么儿时梦想？至于小朋友，短期梦想可能是登上「My Little Show」舞台。四位小舞者以得意造型，为大家呈献一段可爱的爵士舞表演，展现花了一星期练舞的成果。另边厢，九岁女生坦言享受在观众面前弹奏乐曲，并带来柴可夫斯基的一首进行曲，努力练习所花的心机并没有白费！

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 改编自人气绘本。各位小朋友快跟著无人不知的名侦探屁屁侦探全面出击，透过细心观察及推理，侦破各类案件吧！

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 嫲嫲替小丸子的口罩刺了四叶草，后者戴上后好运连连，但测验当天，口罩却被妈妈洗了未干透。小丸子发现烘火堆不止温暖，更能抚慰心灵，妙用无穷，可惜家中落叶枯枝用尽，唯有四出寻求火堆。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 野性四季：珍稀野生动物在中国粤

programme.title: 不可能任务粤PG
programme.desc: 徐荣、孔德贤、郑衍峰、林钰洧、梁允瑜检视过往四项《不可能任务》片段，自觉容易应付，节目组遂向五人派遣新任务……先接受以啤牌砌出三层高金字塔的考验，大学修读建造工程的德贤却被难倒？钰洧妙用小智慧，「取巧」过关！五人在香港大学觅路前行，走进了土木工程学系的活动室，获区达光教授给予任务，是要跟小学生比赛；题目是限时三十分钟，采用意大利粉及指定材料搭建桥梁模型，并通过承重测试。艺员们可会不敌一众同学仔？

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤

programme.title: 甜心先生粤

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2789粤
programme.desc: 力莲发现不少员工午膳后迟迟未返回岗位，源于多了新客人在Cafe长期「打趸」有关，遂设法解决。另一边厢，尚善不喜坐困办公室，反而到Cafe工作，办公方式更「亲民」且灵活，效率大增。某公司更因认同尚善的理念，与接龙合作，带来利益。尚善获敢威赞赏，力莲不甘示弱，也长驻Cafe，Andy、Ivan遂往该处博取表现，获力莲称赞并得到好处。其他人仿傚，纷纷涌到Cafe工作，引发不少问题……

programme.title: 康业信贷快递物业贷款呈献：正义女神#16粤PG
programme.desc: 邵玲探望感化少年却差点受伤，被跟踪而至的雅文目睹；其后，少年遭偷袭打伤。惠知与邵玲相聚时巧遇雅文，对眼前少女留下印象……励梅出狱后，一反常态向邵玲道歉，邵玲心软，邵文却对此极度反感，刚巧家中名表不翼而飞，邵文怀疑是励梅所偷。邵文审理「少女杀猫案」，被告正是雅文。惠知觉得杀猫案背后或有隐情，主动了解案件详情，思义不解为何惠知要如此关注虐待动物的案件……邵玲认为是雅文所做，却不明白她要坚持不认罪……

programme.title: 大生意人#11粤普
programme.desc: 万茶大会当日，平原巧遇微服前来的慈禧，慈禧想尝兰雪茶，平原为她泡茶，并对万茶大会只为敛财而感愤愤不平。紫轩扮作丫鬟奉茶，平原心感不妙，阻止慈禧喝下她的茶。恭亲王被慈禧训斥一番，平原则获赐匾天下第一茶。

programme.title: 试真D粤PG
programme.desc: 深圳有宾馆被指「照骗」，嘉洛实地视察，瞓身记录最真实的负评报告。为迎合美仪姐的滋补要求，节目组悉心安排瓦煲汤水专门店。朱仔从容享用「牛鞭汤」兼吃汤渣，表情管理失败的GM亦冲破底线，试试「蝎子汤」。超市新食品「红黑榜」大检阅，团队为观众「试真D」！「红品」肉松法包名不符实，「黑品」牛肉饼却获平反？包装凤爪竟吃出洗洁精味道；榴芒班戟又可否令抗拒榴梿的GM扭转态度？另追加整蛊坤哥大作战，咖啡杯藏彩蛋……

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤 及 鼎植口腔呈献：齿中守护你粤
及时雨信贷呈献：谈判专家#9粤
programme.desc: 文静欲离开国栋与家聪一起，家聪不舍与简洁多年感情而婉拒。简洁知国栋替家聪隐瞒婚外情，大骂国栋，反被国栋责须自我检讨。家聪终承认有婚外情，并求简洁原谅。家聪向文静提出分手，文静无法接受。简洁开心与家聪的问题得已解决，决定提早休假陪家聪旅行。简洁意外再目睹家聪与文静亲热，精神陷入崩溃，更缺席谈判行动。国栋查问简洁缺席原因，简洁不忍将实情告知，只嘱其不要忽略家庭。杨光与可人初次行动表现突出，备受赞赏。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 现代都市人手机不离手，过度依赖或引致「手机失智症」。精神科医生指此症并非正式的医学诊断，情况却与老人失智症有些相似。过度使用手机，除了可能令专注力下降，甚至会出现社交障碍。要防止这情况，医生有何建议？嘉宾谢宁坦言与岑建勋离婚后仍相信爱情，并庆幸遇上现任丈夫。她呼吁女性不应为照顾家庭而失去自我，还谈到缘何认为不需为下一代预留过多财富，以及与前夫相处之道。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，陈国宾示范「芝麻蒟蒻炒鸡」。

programme.title: 医度讲粤
programme.desc: 骨质疏松问题可大可小，它更是无声小偷，所以大家都要趁早注意这个问题！《医度讲》本集有对骨质疏松相当感兴趣的艺人黎燕珊到来，还有胡依诺医生为大家解构何谓「骨质疏松」、其成因与高危人士。注册中医师何慧欣和李澄琳营养师，也会在节目中跟大家分享骨质疏松问题的食疗。

programme.title: 五味人生#11粤
programme.desc: 永祯发著高烧，误以为双春等带警察捉拿自己，不分情由袭击她；九妹为了让双春带永祯逃走，竟扮永祯夺门而逃。双春探望九妹，九妹认为廿年前得永祯相救，所以要替他顶罪。永祯发现双春与九妹原是旧识，决定游说胜天出手救九妹。中毒之事告一段落，飞扬公布双春的喜相逢酒楼胜出烹饪比赛，并履行承诺收九妹为徒。永祯、双春及九妹决定不计前事，重新结为好友。在慈善竞投舞伴环节，胜天故意竞投失败，卖鱼胜投得与金凤共舞的权利……

programme.title: 高朋满座#79粤
programme.desc: 在放暑期的婷主动跟朋学煮鲍鱼粥，原来婷扮乖巧，只为见偶像「侧膊」，朋得悉后大怒，更责她肤浅。喜以一身韩服出现，原来喜的韩国偶像诚俊哥即将来港，故特打扮去接机。喜为了偶像表现疯狂，甚至弃药房的生意不顾。

programme.title: 尚食#19粤普
programme.desc: 姚子衿不顾手上伤痛，坚持参与上元佳宴，孟尚食允准。子衿的手伤不知能否完全康复，于是她将这次比试视作最后机会。上元佳宴的比试将以获得皇上赞好的菜式数目多寡决胜负，比试中，两位尚食各有千秋，难分高下。

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 当你沉睡时
programme.desc: 拥有预知梦能力的洪珠，因总是只能梦见未来却无力改变而让她痛苦。不是金汤匙出生也没有优秀的学历及人脉，却总是富有充满正义感的检察官宰璨。两人的相遇为了阻止梦境的可怕事件变成现实，开始相信对方是否能成为扭转未来的人呢?

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 大学成人式-被不良少年迷住3-
programme.desc: 【《鱿鱼游戏》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，众多偶像齐聚一堂，共谱青春爱情剧！！】因一场误会让模范生妍斗与校园恶霸贤浩有了连结，在结束了高中时期的纷扰，进入大学就读的妍斗与贤浩，以为平静的日子将会是日常生活。随著新认识的朋友，两人想解决复杂的误会和矛盾产生，看似复杂的爱情公式，谁才是妍斗最终的选择?

programme.title: 另一种蓝(完)
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 大学成人式-被不良少年迷住3-
programme.desc: 【《鱿鱼游戏》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，众多偶像齐聚一堂，共谱青春爱情剧！！】因一场误会让模范生妍斗与校园恶霸贤浩有了连结，在结束了高中时期的纷扰，进入大学就读的妍斗与贤浩，以为平静的日子将会是日常生活。随著新认识的朋友，两人想解决复杂的误会和矛盾产生，看似复杂的爱情公式，谁才是妍斗最终的选择?

programme.title: 捣蛋拉茶铺
programme.desc: 热爱拉茶的老板，和自信满满的服务生狗狗，在飘著香气的拉茶铺里享受著惬意的时光。然而一切平静，都被一只捣蛋的猴子破坏了！为了赶走猴子，狗狗与猴子的战斗即将展开！

programme.title: 机械城足球队
programme.desc: 每天放学后，机器人艾力都会和朋友们在森林公园的小足球场一起踢足球。有人内向，有人天才，有人爱搞怪，各式各样的人集结成一支很棒的队伍，展开一段热血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 机械城足球队
programme.desc: 每天放学后，机器人艾力都会和朋友们在森林公园的小足球场一起踢足球。有人内向，有人天才，有人爱搞怪，各式各样的人集结成一支很棒的队伍，展开一段热血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫经商失败！崔明吉调包财阀孙女只为让女儿入豪门】琴英淑是一位爱女心切的母亲，性格温厚，在丈夫生意失败时，她也从不抱怨，自愿到殷会长的家里担任管家。女儿京慧出生时便被诊断出心脏疾病，当时家境也很难提供好的医疗资源。在一场车祸中，她意外的将女儿京慧，与财阀孙女世妍互相掉包身分，本该是千金小姐的世妍也因此变为平凡人，在百货担任精品店职员，而京慧更是直接跃升为财团富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，发现原本属于她的富贵人生全被京慧夺走，愤怒之下她改名换姓，决定拿回属于她的一切。

programme.title: 优雅的朋友们
programme.desc: 【夫妇的世界「升级版」！初恋女神现身揭开五人帮隐藏面具】一场离奇猝死与密室谋杀，撕裂大学「五人帮」维持二十年的体面假象。死党万植离世，失踪多年的初恋海淑突然现身，唤醒男人们被西装掩盖的欲望与罪恶。模范人夫宫哲察觉妻子静海疑似出轨，威胁她的教练却随即身亡，监视器与证物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到绝境的妻子、病态迷恋的死党，谁在说谎？当秘密层层揭开，每个人都是嫌疑犯，谁才是最终的杀人凶手？

programme.title: 暖阳之下
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.title: 白夜童话
programme.desc: 【《绅士与小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飙复仇抛夫弃子生母】从小遭母亲抛弃，加上父亲早逝，白夜与哥哥相依为命，性格坚强好胜的她总对哥哥百般依赖，也因嫉妒哥哥与大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁难怀孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分头疼。某天哥哥与生母连络上，面对母亲拒绝相认，哥哥内心大受打击，一晃神就因交通意外不幸离世，得知此事的白夜便将所有愤怒转向母亲，展开一系列的报复计划。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 先热情地打扫吧
programme.desc: 【《红天机》金裕贞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹钧相，上演元气女与洁癖男的浪漫喜剧！！】立志消灭所有细菌，把清洁视为人类崇高使命，拒绝与他人肌肤接触，无法忍受灰尘，经营清洁公司的洁癖执行长张善杰。遇上外表邋遢个性不拘小节的四次元少女吉五雪，毕业后的首份就业工作，努力完成员工清洁使命。极与极相遇的浪漫爱情喜剧。

programme.title: 君九龄
programme.desc: 九龄公主生性善良，喜好医术，一场阴谋使得她失去至亲，骨肉分离，容貌大变。为了查清真相报仇雪恨，九龄隐姓埋名一直蛰伏，靠著坚强的毅力和意志力，苦练技艺，不放过任何蛛丝马迹，最终发现这场阴谋背后还有一段不为人知的皇室辛秘。知晓真相后的九龄，回到京城，在凶手不断的骚扰和攻击中建立了医馆九龄堂，济世救人，受人尊崇。与此同时，朱瓒与清贵公子宁云钊、前夫陆云旗、方家独子方承宇，身份各异、关系复杂的四人，陷入了以九龄为核心的感情漩涡。谁才是九龄的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇

programme.title: 两个人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.title: 先热情地打扫吧
programme.desc: 【《红天机》金裕贞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹钧相，上演元气女与洁癖男的浪漫喜剧！！】立志消灭所有细菌，把清洁视为人类崇高使命，拒绝与他人肌肤接触，无法忍受灰尘，经营清洁公司的洁癖执行长张善杰。遇上外表邋遢个性不拘小节的四次元少女吉五雪，毕业后的首份就业工作，努力完成员工清洁使命。极与极相遇的浪漫爱情喜剧。

programme.desc: Kent’s extreme attempts to cure his toe fungus in time for a pool party cause the fungus to mutate and grow into a fungus-based replica of Kent himself. The Secret Lab Kids have to stop the replicant before it turns the whole lab into a stinky, sticky fungus-farm. When Kent manages to contact aliens, they land at the Edison complex and demand that the Secret Lab kids help them find a very valuable "treasure" that their planet needs. The trouble is, they don't know the earth word for this treasure - sending our kids scrambling to solve this mystery before they get turned into "shrablitz”!

But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Holiday
programme.desc: Captain Captain decides she needs a break from Sandy and Seaweed and books a holiday.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Slippery Floor
programme.desc: The toys wake up to find themselves somewhere else other than the demonstration zone.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Daddy Dropoff
programme.desc: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: Supertato and Tomato find themselves stuck in a slippery bathtub, whilst Evil Pea rampages around the supermarket on a giant soap-squirting machine.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Why Badge
programme.desc: Why do my feet hurt?', Tag asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Roly reveals he's expecting a new baby brother or sister, and the Squirrels have questions.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to help Plinky find her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Feeling Better
programme.desc: It's time to wake up but Tinky Winky isn't feeling well. Soon, Tinky Winky feels better but now Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po don't feel well.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - I Can Be Anything
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and follow their dreams.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - Fly with Fly
programme.desc: Fly is on the lookout for a very special flower known as a rainbow flower. But when Fly's adventure takes her a little too far from Pop Paper City, her friends have to find her and bring her home.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Pyramids
programme.desc: Dog and Pug find Granny Pug by a pyramid. Unfortunately, they disturb two ancient Egyptian gods in the form of a cat and a dog.

programme.desc: Messy and friends rocket into space, but a mischievous Messy sends OKIDO's seasons into chaos! Time to fix this planet wobble.

programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Feeling Better
programme.desc: It's time to wake up but Tinky Winky isn't feeling well. Soon, Tinky Winky feels better but now Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po don't feel well.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - I Can Be Anything
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and follow their dreams.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - Fly with Fly
programme.desc: Fly is on the lookout for a very special flower known as a rainbow flower. But when Fly's adventure takes her a little too far from Pop Paper City, her friends have to find her and bring her home.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Pyramids
programme.desc: Dog and Pug find Granny Pug by a pyramid. Unfortunately, they disturb two ancient Egyptian gods in the form of a cat and a dog.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Planet Wobble
programme.desc: Messy and friends rocket into space, but a mischievous Messy sends OKIDO's seasons into chaos! Time to fix this planet wobble.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Alien Television
programme.desc: Aliens on OKIDO telly? Skateboarders in the satellite?! Everything's upside down! It's up to Messy and his friends to fix it!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Pig Gets Big
programme.desc: Farmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now, Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to go to the hairdressers
programme.desc: JoJo learns how fun the hairdresser's can be when she goes with Gran Gran for a trim. After helping the hairdresser, JoJo also gets her own new style ready for Ezra's party!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Star Renovation
programme.desc: Venus has attempted to redecorate the night sky, but now Sarah can't find any of her favourite constellations...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S23) - Crowning Around
programme.desc: Rajiv feels devastated when he loses his crown, thinking that it's the reason he is good at anything, but he soon learns that can still be really useful.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Pool
programme.desc: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shops
programme.desc: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Wagon Ride
programme.desc: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Banana's Star Appeal
programme.desc: Banana superstar's show is stopped when Pea steals his peel. Supertato races against Evil Pea to get it back but trouble hits when a giant Banana statue collapses onto the stage.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun trying out games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Choreography Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet Duggee's old dance crew and learn that he was kicked out because he couldn't stick to the choreography. The Squirrels are surprised because Duggee is such a good dancer!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - White Cliffs of Dover, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to save the White Cliffs of Dover when Glitch digs for classroom chalk

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch visits Broadway, while the Go Jetters tackle a huge cloud of smog in Central Park.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bullet Train, Japan
programme.desc: All aboard for a high-speed adventure, as the Go Jetters visit Japan's Bullet Train.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S2) - Marina's Mexican Enchiladas
programme.desc: Marina takes us to Mexico, cooking a traditional dish called enchiladas. She entertains her friends with some special guest musicians: a traditional mariachi band.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Orangutans
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to the rainforests of Borneo in South-East Asia in search of an orangutan mother and her baby.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Ship Parts Song
programme.desc: Captain Captain discovers that Sandy and Seaweed don't know any of the correct names for the parts of the ship, so she decides to teach them through a song!

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Sidney the Soldier
programme.desc: Krash wakes up and notices a toy that he has never seen before.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Super Sandcastle
programme.desc: Supertato and the Veggies have built a super sandcastle, but Evil Pea wants to storm it by firing her hordes of Mini Peas at it with her pea shooter.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - This Way, That Way
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go 'this way, that way' on a Tubby Car journey to the Hidey Hup. The Tubby Spinny goes 'this way, that way' too.

programme.desc: Back stroke and doggy paddle, flips, and roly-polys. The animals talk about all the fun stuff when swimming.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Watch a Family Film
programme.desc: JoJo finds something old in the cupboard - it's a video tape. Time for a Gran Gran plan to see what's on it. Soon, they are off to the library to find out if Terrence can help.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Playing Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing in the clubhouse. Naughty Monkey arrives and causes chaos! He later returns to his home to relax when there is a knock at his door. It's his cousins, come to visit.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Singing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out on a walk in the countryside. Its been a long walk and the squirrels are starting to get tired, but it's a long way back. Don't worry, Duggee has his singing badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Solar Race: Australia

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Leek

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Okra

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it's not Evil Pea after all.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Lullaby
programme.desc: During Tiddlytubbies' Sleepybyes, RuRu is wide awake. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to sing him a lullaby.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S4) - Octopus
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'octopus' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a giant octopus, a tiny octopus, a swimming octopus and a gardening octopus!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Mojo Mail

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - TV Shop

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Sticky Gecko
programme.desc: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Ice Cream
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a lick of each other's ice cream. But they are so focused on making sure each lick is fair, they don't notice their ice creams are melting.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Meerkat Pups
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to Botswana, Africa and embark on a baby animal mission to help a meerkat family move home. Along the way, Andy meets some zebra and must race across an enormous salt pan to escape a hungry jackal.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Sticks
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play with a stick that makes the perfect magic wand. They visit Patch, who has a tasty recipe - sticky stick critters!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Making Friends Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are off for a Jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Camping Badge

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...
